selfHosted.title: Local registry
selfHosted.description: A registry:3 container managed by aoox. Push address: {url}

dockerUnavailable.title: Docker is unreachable
dockerUnavailable.description: The API cannot reach the Docker engine (check DOCKER_SOCKET and the socket mount in the container).

selfHosted.domainNote: Requires the reverse proxy to be enabled with an ACME email set — otherwise no certificate is issued and docker push will reject the domain.

provision.title: Enable local registry
provision.description: Choose where images are stored. It cannot be changed without deleting and re-enabling the registry.
provision.noDestinations: There is no S3 destination yet — add one under Instance backup first if you want to use object storage.

ready.title: Registry ready
ready.description: Save this password now — it is shown only once. After that it is stored encrypted on the server.
ready.localhostNote: This localhost address only works when the command is run directly on this server (e.g. over an SSH terminal) — not from your own computer. To push/pull from anywhere over HTTPS, set a Custom domain on this card after closing the dialog.

removeDialog.title: Delete local registry?
removeDialog.description: The container is stopped and deleted. Choose whether the image data is deleted too.

unmanaged.title: A registry container already exists on this server
unmanaged.description: A container named aoox-registry is running here, but it is not registered in aoox (for example after an instance restore or a database move). Enabling the registry would collide with it.
unmanaged.descriptionMember: A container named aoox-registry exists on this server but is not registered in aoox. Ask an owner to replace it.
unmanaged.dialogDescription: The existing aoox-registry container is deleted and a new registry is created and registered. Its data volumes are kept, so images already pushed stay available. The login password is regenerated and shown once; anything that used the old password must log in again.

missing.title: The registry container is missing
missing.description: aoox still has a record of the local registry, but the aoox-registry container no longer exists. Remove the record, then enable the registry again.
missing.descriptionMember: aoox still has a record of the local registry, but its container no longer exists. Ask an owner to fix it.

empty.title: Enable the local registry
empty.body: Store the images aoox builds, so you can roll back and deploy to other servers.
empty.bodyMember: It stores the images aoox builds for rollbacks and other servers. Ask an owner to enable it.

external.description: Docker Hub, GHCR, GitLab, or another registry. Credentials are stored encrypted.
external.emptyBody: Add Docker Hub, GHCR, GitLab or another registry to deploy private images and pull them with saved credentials.
external.emptyBodyMember: Private images from Docker Hub, GHCR or GitLab need a saved registry. Ask an owner or admin to add one.
external.name: Name

dialog.title: External registry
dialog.description: For Docker Hub use the URL docker.io; for GHCR ghcr.io; for GitLab registry.gitlab.com.

repositories.empty: There are no images yet. First push: docker push <registry>/<name>:<tag>
repositories.noTagsManage: No tags (the manifests were deleted). Use the "Delete image" button to remove this repository from the catalog entirely.

deleteTag.title: Delete tag {name}?
deleteTag.description: The registry deletes its manifest, not just the tag name.
deleteTag.shared: These tags point to the same manifest and are deleted too: {names}.
deleteTag.diskNote: Disk space is only reclaimed after a garbage collect.

deleteImage.title: Delete image {name}?
deleteImage.description: This removes the repository from the catalog entirely: all {count, plural, one {# tag} other {# tags}} and their manifests, its folder in storage, then an automatic garbage collect. The registry restarts briefly so its blob cache is cleared too — pushing again under the same name still works afterwards. This cannot be undone.
deleteImage.usedBy: Used by {count, plural, one {# application} other {# applications}}: {names}. Rollback or redeploy without a build to that image will fail once it is deleted.

page.description: Where built images are stored — for rollback and deploying to multiple servers.
